comment: BACKFILL. T-002 reached Status: Done on the independent quality-gate cycle-1 PASS (reports/quality-gate/epic-195-a7-compatibility/T-002.md, ledger seq0667) without this contract or its evidence bundle ever being authored; a git log --all --full-history search confirms neither file existed on any branch. This contract is NOT a record of the seq0667 gate: every check whose evidence path is under verification/qg-backfill/ was re-run at the current HEAD. The Red->Green pair is the deliberate exception and stays historical: red-bash.log and green-bash.log were captured at implementation time by the TDD cycle itself and cannot be re-created after the fact -- a Red run against the finished implementation would be green, so re-running it would manufacture a false artifact. Both files are unchanged since they entered history and are named here as what they are. Risk high and Required Workflow tdd are transcribed from tasks.md#T-002 (Security Boundary B1); the high tier minimum adds requirement-traceability to the medium set, which is why this backfill also had to create specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/traceability.json. Full rationale: specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/verification/qg-backfill/README.md.

checks.waiver_reason: stack: shell -- T-002's deliverables are the POSIX-shell/PowerShell twins tests/capture-golden-baseline.{sh,ps1}, tests/promote-golden-baseline.{sh,ps1} and tests/golden-baseline-contract.tests.{sh,ps1}, plus a JSON manifest. This repository configures no shell linter (no shellcheck and no PSScriptAnalyzer invocation in tests/run-all.{sh,ps1} or .github/workflows/test.yml), so there is no lint command whose output could be recorded. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

stack: shell -- shell and PowerShell are untyped and this repository configures no static type-check command for either runtime. The one structured artifact, the golden-baseline manifest, is JSON whose shape is enforced by the contract suite itself rather than by a type checker. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No service or network integration is in T-002's scope. The capture path shells out to git and to the product's own install/uninstall surfaces, and that interaction is exercised end to end by the contract suite recorded under acceptance-tests rather than by a separate integration layer.

stack: shell -- no compile or bundle step exists for shell/PowerShell scripts and a JSON manifest; there is no dist/ artifact and design.md's Deployment / CI Plan records no build obligation for this task. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No independently startable application, service, or UI. The two deliverable entry points are batch CLI scripts, and the contract suite invokes both of them for real -- including the CI-set and approved-by-omitted refusal paths -- so a separate smoke run would duplicate the acceptance evidence rather than add to it.

No baseline-behavior.md exists for this feature and T-002 is new additive tooling rather than a change to existing behavior, so no differential obligation attaches (references/differential-test-policy.md). The canonical golden baseline this task creates is the compatibility oracle for later tasks; it is not a differential baseline for T-002's own change.
No user-facing UI surface. traceability.md's Layer Coverage records UX and Frontend as reasoned N/A for the whole feature: 'no GUI, view, dialog, menu item, or human interactive shell surface'.

ds_profile: none -- this repository carries no design-system/ directory and T-002 touches no UI-layer file, so check-design-system's warn-phase conditional control does not activate (risk-gate-matrix.md footnote 4).
